goal_spec.objective: Remediate all 46 approved audit findings identified in path_a_seed across the codebase
non_goals: Refactoring unrelated to the identified audit findings

module_contracts.name: server-core
invariants: Mid-stream network resets or SSE truncations must report failure to circuit breaker (verification_obligation: test stream failures)
failure_modes: Backend socket reset or timeout (caller receives error SSE or failover to candidate)
module_contracts.validation_boundary: Validates incoming HTTP requests and SSE event structures against JSON schemas

module_contracts.name: backend-auth
invariants: Env-var credential resolution must consistently use readCredential across routing and header construction (verification_obligation: unit test authEnv & backend)
failure_modes: Missing or invalid credential (caller receives unauthenticated error or failover)
module_contracts.validation_boundary: Validates target existence and authorization credential presence

module_contracts.name: config-routing
invariants: Subagent directive parsing must strictly restrict @relay: matching to explicitly authorized user prompt blocks (verification_obligation: prompt injection security tests)
failure_modes: Invalid configuration format (throws RoutingError or configuration validation error)
module_contracts.validation_boundary: Validates schema of configuration file and model routing parameters

module_contracts.name: cli-tools
invariants: SHELL_SAFE regex and positional argument parsing must correctly handle backslashes and flag ordering (verification_obligation: test CLI argument quoting)
failure_modes: Unknown command or invalid flag options
module_contracts.validation_boundary: Validates CLI option flags and command names

obligations.description: Implement module "server-core" per its finalized contract (inputs: HTTP request payloads, Configuration state, Backend response streams → outputs: Proxied HTTP responses, SSE streams, Circuit breaker failure metrics; validation boundary: Validates incoming HTTP requests and SSE event structures against JSON schemas).
Mid-stream network resets or SSE truncations must report failure to circuit breaker (verification_obligation: test stream failures)
Handle failure mode: Backend socket reset or timeout (caller receives error SSE or failover to candidate)

Implement module "backend-auth" per its finalized contract (inputs: Target specification, Environment credentials → outputs: Upstream HTTP response, Resolved auth headers; validation boundary: Validates target existence and authorization credential presence).
Env-var credential resolution must consistently use readCredential across routing and header construction (verification_obligation: unit test authEnv & backend)
Handle failure mode: Missing or invalid credential (caller receives unauthenticated error or failover)

Implement module "config-routing" per its finalized contract (inputs: Raw configuration files, Incoming prompt / system messages → outputs: Parsed configuration object, Relay directives and subagent flags; validation boundary: Validates schema of configuration file and model routing parameters).
Subagent directive parsing must strictly restrict @relay: matching to explicitly authorized user prompt blocks (verification_obligation: prompt injection security tests)
Handle failure mode: Invalid configuration format (throws RoutingError or configuration validation error)

Implement module "cli-tools" per its finalized contract (inputs: Command line arguments, Environment flags → outputs: Parsed CLI commands, Quoted shell arguments; validation boundary: Validates CLI option flags and command names).
SHELL_SAFE regex and positional argument parsing must correctly handle backslashes and flag ordering (verification_obligation: test CLI argument quoting)
Handle failure mode: Unknown command or invalid flag options

test_specs.name: Mid-stream network resets or SSE truncations must report failure
assertions: POSITIVE: Successfully report outcome to circuit breaker when sse stream encounters mid-flight reset
NEGATIVE: Ensure sse stream truncation does not bypass circuit breaker failure logging

test_specs.name: Handle failure mode: Backend socket reset or timeout
assertions: POSITIVE: Emit error sse event when backend socket resets
NEGATIVE: Do not leave sse stream open when backend socket times out

test_specs.name: Env-var credential resolution must consistently use readCredential
assertions: POSITIVE: Resolve auth key successfully using readCredential in authenv
NEGATIVE: Do not directly read process.env in authenv without calling readCredential

test_specs.name: Handle failure mode: Missing or invalid credential
assertions: POSITIVE: Handle missing credential in obl-backend-auth-fail-1 by raising unauthenticated error
NEGATIVE: Do not issue unauthenticated request upstream when obl-backend-auth-fail-1 credential is missing

test_specs.name: Subagent directive parsing must strictly restrict @relay: matching
assertions: POSITIVE: Parse @relay: directives successfully from user text blocks in obl-config-routing-inv-1
NEGATIVE: Do not parse @relay: directives from injected file contents in obl-config-routing-inv-1

test_specs.name: Handle failure mode: Invalid configuration format
assertions: POSITIVE: Raise routingerror when configuration format is invalid
NEGATIVE: Do not fall back to default routing on invalid routingerror configuration

test_specs.name: SHELL_SAFE regex and positional argument parsing must correctly handle backslashes
assertions: POSITIVE: Quote backslash characters correctly in cli shell argument rendering
NEGATIVE: Do not leave backslashes unquoted in cli argument output

test_specs.name: Handle failure mode: Unknown command or invalid flag options
assertions: POSITIVE: Reject unknown command in obl-cli-tools-fail-1 with exit code
NEGATIVE: Do not execute mutating operations for unknown options in obl-cli-tools-fail-1
